description: This file contains database migration scripts for the Superset project, specifically for migrating filter set configurations to a new format. It includes functions for upgrading and downgrading filter set data within dashboard metadata stored in a database.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Declarative ORM class representing dashboards in the database, used for querying and updating dashboard metadata.

methods.name: upgrade_filter_set
methods.description: Converts filter set data to a new format, moving and renaming fields accordingly.

methods.name: downgrade_filter_set
methods.description: Reverts filter set data to the previous format, restoring original field names and structure.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process on all dashboards with filter set configurations.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Performs the downgrade process on all dashboards with filter set configurations.
